_authorship: Written offline by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from the verified H1V pipeline numbers (pipeline/out/facts_for_authoring.json). 01_build_monsoon_analytics.py re-checks every number, ID and forbidden phrase before accepting a text.

contractors.CT01: Sahyadri Infra Works (fictional) handled 337 jobs worth ₹17.21M in this synthetic record, and its repairs held up well: 14% reopened within 30 days against 25% expected for its method mix, about 11 points better. It met SLA on 62% of jobs, 13 points above the benchmark for its wards (37% of jobs were in the most low-lying quartile). SLA performance is shown alongside low-lying ward exposure. The dataset does not establish causation. Average cost is 1.06× the rate card, though WO25-00611 (2.28×) and WO25-01723 (1.75×) merit a measurement-book check. Suggested improvement: confirm DLP status before billing surface repairs; 41 jobs need that review.

cases.WO25-00611: WO25-00611 is a road cave-in repair in ward B by Sahyadri Infra Works (fictional): excavation, pipeline repair and a PQC patch over 27.5 sqm, recorded at ₹410,330 against a rate-card expectation of ₹180,000. That is 2.28 times the expectation, or ₹230,330 above it, which puts it in the very-high variance review band. Two complaints are linked to it, so the work looks traceable; the question for the measurement book is why the recorded amount sits so far above the standard rate. This is a prompt for review, not a finding of wrongdoing.
cases.WO25-02486: WO25-02486 raises a possible duplicate-billing question. It is a pump and debris removal job on RD0216 in ward L, recorded at ₹112,441 with no complaint linked, and it matches an earlier job on the same road, WO25-01255, in method and in area (2.8 sqm), three days earlier and with the same contractor. The costs differ by only about 0.55%. Neither the amount nor the method is unusual on its own; the pairing with no linked complaint is what makes it worth a site-evidence and linkage check. A duplicate candidate means please verify, not confirmed.
cases.WO25-01723: WO25-01723 is a road cave-in repair on RD0271 in ward S, recorded at ₹315,328 for excavation, pipeline repair and a PQC patch (30.3 sqm). The road was resurfaced on 2023-02-28 and is marked as still under its defect liability period, so a surface repair billed to the municipality may be something the original contractor should cover. That needs a contract and scope check, because DLP status alone does not prove liability. Separately, the amount is 1.75 times the rate-card expectation of ₹180,000.
cases.BMC25-004589: A Hindi complaint, BMC25-004589, logged on the MyBMC app in mid-August 2025, says that flooding at Vikhroli (ward N) is stopping an ambulance from getting through. Its GPS pin lies about 3 metres from RD0251, an ambulance-entry road for an emergency hospital, and 24 people upvoted it, yet it is still open with no work order linked. Its category is marked unverified because the Hindi wording is generic, but the ambulance reference makes it a good first case for a ward officer to check.
